# Pals Travel & Leisure

> Pals Travel & Leisure Ltd is a travel company in Karen, Nairobi, Kenya, operating since 2010. It plans private, tailor-made safaris and holidays in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda, and arranges hotels, airport transfers, flights, car hire with or without a driver, private school transport, business travel, events and visa applications.

## Contact
- Phone: +254 757 129 599, +254 722 331 204
- WhatsApp: +254 722 331 204
- Bookings and reservations: reservations@palstravelleisure.co.ke
- General enquiries: info@palstravelleisure.co.ke
- Office: House No. 128, Nandi Road, Karen, Nairobi, Kenya
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 to 18:00 (East Africa Time). Closed Sunday.

## Festive season holiday packages
Kenya stays are valid 20 December 2026 to 3 January 2027 only, priced per person in Kenyan shillings (KES). City holidays abroad are on sale now until 3 January 2027, priced per person sharing in US dollars (USD), flights not included. All prices are subject to availability, and confirmed in writing before booking. Optional add-ons (for example SGR train tickets, transport, park fees, airport transfers, extra nights and activities) are available at extra cost.

## Services
- [Holiday packages and safaris](https://palstravelleisure.co.ke/safaris): packages above, and tailor-made safaris planned on request
- [Car hire](https://palstravelleisure.co.ke/car-hire): safari Land Cruisers, pop-up roof vans, executive saloons, HiAce vans, coasters and coach buses, with or without a driver
- [Hotels, airport transfers, air ticketing, events and visas](https://palstravelleisure.co.ke/services)
- [Private school transport in Nairobi](https://palstravelleisure.co.ke/school-transport): trained drivers, a conductor on every vehicle, scheduled routes, special needs support
- [Business travel and events](https://palstravelleisure.co.ke/business): business trips, official appointments, business set-up support, investor site visits, conferences, incentives and team building
- Medical travel: treatment abroad from Kenya, and visitors coming to Kenya for treatment
- Trips home for Kenyans living abroad, and travel abroad for work or study
- [Careers and Pals Ambassadors](https://palstravelleisure.co.ke/careers): jobs, and a paid referral programme for students
- [Contact and enquiries](https://palstravelleisure.co.ke/contact): enquiries are free and answered within one working day

## How booking works
Sending an enquiry is free and does not create a booking. A booking is confirmed only in writing and after the deposit stated in the quotation. See [Bookings, cancellations and refunds](https://palstravelleisure.co.ke/legal/bookings).

## Languages and currencies
The website is available in English, Kiswahili, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Russian and Arabic. Non-English text is translated with the help of AI. Prices are set in KES; other currencies shown on the site are approximate conversions.
